achievements.name: High Octane Output
achievements.description: Production line performance has shown an impressive acceleration in output. Buckle up, it’s full speed ahead for the business.

achievements.name: High-Octane Efficiency
achievements.description: Fantastic job! Hyperdrive engaged. A dazzling, well-oiled performance. You understand that efficiency is one of the drivers of profit.

achievements.name: Efficiency Awareness
achievements.description: Good work, you have achieved the Efficiency Awareness Award and your business is gearing up for greatness. Don’t let poor efficiency stall further progress.

achievements.name: Bumper Output
achievements.description: Good work, the production line is ticking over nicely and factory output is racing ahead but don’t take your eyes off the road ahead.

achievements.name: Mainstream Production
achievements.description: Good work, your fifth hundred car has rolled off the production line. Are your management skills agile enough to rev your business up even further?

achievements.name: Mass Production
achievements.description: Congratulations, you have achieved the landmark production of one thousand cars and are well on the road to competing in the mass market. It’s business in the fast lane from now on. Can you keep up?

achievements.name: Start-up Production
achievements.description: Well done, you have a functional production line and your start-up business has produced its first century run of vehicles! Do you have the drive to take production all the way?

achievements.name: Millionized revenue
achievements.description: A proud day for the car factory, you have taken one million dollars in revenue. Keep firing on all cylinders.

achievements.name: Premium Car Production
achievements.description: Your top-quality innovation and investment strategy has paid off and caught the attention of some discerning customers. A sound reputation means the road ahead could be paved with success.

achievements.name: Full Throttle Revenue
achievements.description: Bravo, your business revenue stream was fast and furious for a while. A truly turbo-boosted performance.

achievements.name: Middle of the Road Output
achievements.description: Well done, you are steering your company in the right direction by keeping an eye on the clock. Keep rolling out those cars.

achievements.name: Revenue Overdrive
achievements.description: Congratulations on smashing the ten million dollar revenue barrier. You have shown great drive and determination. Is now a good time to remind you that revenue is not the same as profit?

achievements.name: Power Trip
achievements.description: 'Electric power is everywhere present in unlimited quantities and can drive the world's machinery without the need of coal, oil, gas'-Nikola Tesla. Self-sufficiency is a thing of beauty. Build a power plant and start feeding the robotic army. They're hungry!

achievements.name: Off-Grid
achievements.description: Unplugged production. Keep the lines running from the power within. Let's go off-grid!

achievements.name: Job Creator
achievements.description: Recruit as if human labour is going out of fashion! You've got the robots but employees are the oil that keeps the lines running and the profits rolling in

achievements.name: Robot Army
achievements.description: If the factory doesn't look like an alien dreadnought mothership maybe you need a few more robots but remember, idle robots are the devil's work.

achievements.name: Efficient Layout
achievements.description: The first rule of any technology used in a business is that automation applied to an efficient operation will magnify the efficiency'-Bill Gates. It's time to tighten that production line layout.

achievements.name: Innovator
achievements.description: The zoo of the new – produce an irresistible model packed with novel features, let it purr, kick ass, or glide then let it run free!

achievements.name: Min Spec
achievements.description: Keep it simple, keep it clean, keep it affordable, keep it rolling off the production line! 'Simplicity is the ultimate in sophistication'-Leonardo di Vinci (long before cars were invented, obviously).

achievements.name: Experienced Manager
achievements.description: You’ve got to put in the hours to get ahead. 'The only source of knowledge is experience'-Albert Einstein.

achievements.name: Industry Veteran
achievements.description: In this ever-evolving industry, there is no such thing as 'enough' experience

achievements.name: Wide Product Range
achievements.description: All our customers are individuals, they want choice and they want it now. Can you deliver?

achievements.name: Big Spender
achievements.description: You've got to speculate to accumulate. Go ahead and speculate like a philosophy graduate, but don't lose track of logic and reason completely!

achievements.name: Research Addict
achievements.description: 'Bring the future into the present so that you can do something about it now'-Alan Lakein. If you're not researching tomorrow's tech today, your business may be here today, gone tomorrow. Keep ahead of the competition

achievements.name: Luxury Range: Sophistication sells
achievements.description: There is an old saying, ‘Luxury is the mother of innovation’ or something like that. Sell over $10 million worth of cars from the luxury range priced over $70k.

achievements.name: Marketing: Let’s go mad!
achievements.description: Mad men and women of the marketing division, help get our fantastic products in pole position ready to race out of the showroom. Spend over $5 million on marketing in a single game.

achievements.name: Zero Emissions: And breathe…
achievements.description: Be a champion of clean air and produce a battery of 500 electric cars in a single game.

achievements.name: Local production: Keeping it in-house
achievements.description: Extend the web of production. Source just-in-time components from just in-house production just in case those suppliers let you down. Produce 500 local components in a single hour.

achievements.name: Rapid Assembly: We’re on a deadline
achievements.description: Does your production line have traction? Get a grip and produce 500 cars in a single 10 hour shift.

achievements.name: High-End cars: Executive order
achievements.description: High octane executives love their plush cars. Produce and sell 500 cars from the expensive range in a single game.

achievements.name: Customer Awareness: it’s all about the brand
achievements.description: Our brand is a fuel-injected mix of reputation, vision and our journey. Make sure customers are along for the ride and maintain a brand awareness of over 75% for 10 straight hours.

achievements.name: Production: scale it up
achievements.description: From blue-print to juggernaut. Rev up, design and build a factory from scratch and produce 6,000 cars in a single game.
